t: This is St George's Drive, a street in the City of Westminster. It takes its name from Saint George, an early Christian martyr who, by tradition, was a soldier in the Roman army. He was sentenced to death for refusing to recant his Christian faith, and he became one of the most venerated saints in Christianity. Since the Crusades he has been honoured especially as a military saint. He is also respected by Druze and by some Muslims as a martyr of monotheistic faith.
